qa.title: Q128 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: If both this follower and a Hare of Illusions are on my field, and I play Hare of Illusions's activated ability, banishing this card, will this follower's "Whenever an amulet leaves your field, deal 2 damage to each enemy leader and enemy follower on the field" ability trigger?
qa.answer: Yes, it will.

qa.title: Q127 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: If multiple amulets leave my field at the same time, does this follower's "Whenever an amulet leaves your field, deal 2 damage to each enemy leader and enemy follower on the field" ability trigger for each amulet?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.title: Q265 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: If there are no enemy followers on the field, or there are only followers with Aura, can I still play this follower's "Select an enemy follower on the field and engage it" activated ability?
qa.answer: No. If there are no enemy followers on the field that you can select, then you cannot play the ability or pay the cost of putting this amulet into your cemetery. Note that if there is an engaged enemy follower without Aura, you may select it and play this ability. In that case, the selected follower's state would remain unchanged.

qa.title: Q130 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: When I play this amulet's "Banish each follower on the field" activated ability, will it only banish enemy followers on the field?
qa.answer: No. All followers on all players' fields will be banished.

qa.title: Q129 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: Can I pay the cost for either of this amulet's activated abilities when it's engaged?
qa.answer: No. Both costs require you to engage it, so if it's already engaged, you cannot pay either cost.
